description: Check which structured data (schema.org JSON-LD) a website carries that AI engines read: Organization, Article, FAQPage, Product, Person, BreadcrumbList and the like, across up to ten pages, with what is missing. Use it when someone asks about schema markup, structured data or rich results for AI search. Reads public pages only; changes nothing.
